item.description: Pontiff delivers forceful speech on final day in Peru as he travels from high in the Andes into the Amazon Pope Leo XIV has demanded justice for environmental defenders killed for protecting the Amazon and backed efforts by Indigenous peoples to stop their lands from being ravaged by logging and illegal mining. On the penultimate day of his South American tour, Leo on Sunday travelled into the Peruvian Amazon and channelled one of Pope Francis’s core teachings that links care for the most vulnerable with care for God’s creation. item.title: Muere Miguel Ángel Félix Gallardo, "el Jefe de Jefes" del narcotráfico mexicano
item.description: El histórico narcotraficante Miguel Ángel Félix Gallardo falleció este 15 de noviembre a los 80 años. "El Jefe de Jefes" fue uno de los artífices del surgimiento de los grandes carteles en México y estuvo detrás del homicidio de un agente de la DEA, por el que fue condenado. Su salud se había deteriorado notablemente en los últimos años por padecimientos como hipertensión, diabetes y sordera. Informe de nuestro corresponsal, Jorge Hurtado. Creó el Fondo Milagro para recaudar donaciones, pero tres meses después la reconstrucción es casi nula. item.title: Climate response: Why previous warming makes all the difference
item.description: Global temperatures may continue to rise even after human CO₂ emissions stop. The temperature change that follows is known as the zero emissions commitment (ZEC), and it is often assumed to be close to zero. A study led by the Met Office Hadley Center, with co-authors from several institutions including the University of Liverpool, found that the temperature response depends on how much warming has already occurred. Fuente: Phys.org.

item.title: 2 Infants buried in Peru about 1,600 years ago; one had a rare fatal birth defect called cyclopia
item.description: In southern Peru, archaeologists uncovered the remains of two infants buried together, one exhibiting cyclopia. Genetic analysis confirmed that the infant with cyclopia had trisomy 13, a chromosomal condition. Their burial in a single ceramic vessel reveals insights into ancient funerary practices. Researchers highlighted that the infant's condition did not result in unusual treatment in life or death. This discovery emphasizes the historical presence of congenital differences in human populations. Fuente: The Times of India - World.

item.title: Urban expansion causes ecological collapse in streams in the São Paulo Metropolitan Area
item.description: The advance of urbanization in the São Paulo Metropolitan Area in Brazil is causing the collapse of food webs in local streams. A study published in August in the journal Nature Cities reveals that the impact of the metropolis goes far beyond a simple reduction in species. Degradation selectively eliminates organisms based on their size and simplifies ecological interactions. Networks of 190 connections plummet to just three. Fuente: Phys.org.
